win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 8 or more symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Golden Multiplier Bombs are multiplicative and can have one of the following multipliers: x2, x3, x5 or x10

scatters.name: LOAD THE CANNONS
scatters.behavior:
Trigger the LOAD THE CANNONS bonus game with 10 free spins by landing 4 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the BASE GAME.

 During this bonus there is a higher chance of landing the Cannon symbol.

 Landing 3 BONUS symbols at the same time in the bonus game awards +5 free spins.

scatters.name: FIRE AT WILL
scatters.behavior:
Trigger the FIRE AT WILL bonus game with 10 free spins by landing 5 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the BASE GAME.

 During this bonus there is a higher chance of landing the Cannon symbol. Highlighted squares persist for the entire duration of the bonus!

 Landing 3 BONUS symbols at the same time in the bonus game awards +5 free spins.

multipliers.name: CANNON FEATURE
multipliers.behavior:
When a winning combination occurs each symbol position that was part of the win becomes a highlighted square.

 If a Cannon symbol is present on the grid at the end of the spin the Cannon feature will trigger. When the feature triggers, Multiplier Bombs are placed on every highlighted square. All Multiplier Bombs will then explode and reveal a multiplier which is added to a total multiplier one by one from left to right, top to bottom.

 Multiplier Bombs can either be additive or multiplicative. Additive Bombs add their value to the total multiplier, while multiplicative Bombs multiply the value of the total multiplier.

 There are four different Multiplier Bombs:

multipliers.name: Low-Value Bombs
multipliers.behavior: Low-Value Bombs are additive and can have one of the following multipliers: x2, x3, x4 or x5

multipliers.name: Medium-Value Bombs
multipliers.behavior: Medium-Value Bombs are additive and can have one of the following multipliers: x10, x15, x20 or x25

multipliers.name: High-Value Bombs
multipliers.behavior: High-Value Bombs are additive and can have one of the following multipliers: x50, x75 or x100

multipliers.name: Golden Multiplier Bomb
multipliers.behavior:
Golden Multiplier Bombs are multiplicative and can have one of the following multipliers: x2, x3, x5 or x10

 Once all Bombs are revealed, the total multiplier amount will be used to multiply the value of the Tumble Win and the new Tumble Win value is then awarded.

specials.name: TUMBLE WIN
specials.behavior:
All wins are added to the total Tumble Win above the grid. After adding the win amount to the Tumble Win, all winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in to take their place and possibly award additional wins.

 The total Tumble Win amount is awarded at the end of every spin.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Yarr, matey! Unsheath yer sabers and load yer pistols, it’s time to embark on a keel-hauling adventure on the high seas in Pirate Bonanza! This game with all-scatter wins is played on a 6-reel, 5-row grid, with a maximum possible win of 10,000 times your bet! Are you ready? We’ve got some plunder to claim!

 The maximum win can be achieved in all game modes.

 Connections of 8 or more identical symbols anywhere on the grid result in wins. The squares of winning symbols become highlighted. If a Cannon symbol is present on the grid it triggers the Cannon Feature once all cascade
